While choice-of-law and forum selection provisions are typically upheld, the overbreadth of the non-compete (Section 12.1) may raise enforceability challenges under state law. Co. supports severability of arbitration clauses from challenged contract terms. We recommend proceeding with arbitration as stipulated unless a motion to invalidate the clause is strategically warranted. A motion to compel arbitration may be appropriate if the opposing party resists.
